Struggle to open up in relationships or start difficult conversations?

This video breaks down why hard conversations feel terrifying—fear of rejection, loss aversion, fear of change—and how avoiding them silently damages intimacy.

You’ll learn a 4-step framework to express your truth without triggering defensiveness, create emotional safety, and repair conflict in a healthy, collaborative way. 

I also share a powerful relationship tool to help you navigate fights and strengthen connection.

In this video you’ll learn:
✓ Why difficult conversations feel so overwhelming
✓ How loss aversion affects your communication
✓ The “smallest possible truth” method to get started
✓ How to lower defensiveness and communicate safely
✓ How to co-create solutions and repair rituals

If you want deeper connection, healthier communication, and relationships that evolve with you—this is your guide.

Perfect for: couples, people-pleasers, anxious/avoidant partners, and anyone terrified of emotional vulnerability.
